title: Pi request abort ends monitoring
description: Use a real Pi TUI on a private tmux server with a synthetic loopback provider that stalls after headers. Start monitoring before the first request times out, verify the retry stays monitored without mark start or native acceptance, then exhaust both requests and fail the static review with StopFailure through gateway run.resume and run.get. Uses a disposable home and gateway; no paid calls or operator runs.

pi-request-abort.intent: A static review with no mark start stays monitored through its first stalled Pi request and retry, then fails with the structured timeout reason.
